g.text: mode "app" = one raster frame (432 B) per block,
Both send without pauses; the RFCOMM flow
control sets the pace, so the motor keeps
running (write blocks while the printer is
busy). _drain() waits for the printer's reply
to a status query put behind the job before
Every renderer returns a PIL image in mode 1
(1 bit, 0 = black dots) in the content width.
